items.title: Does ‘eval’ in the workspace path change what your agent does?
items.summary: Your eval might be telling the agent it’s a test before the agent reads a single instruction. Eval tools need a fresh folder for every run, and the easiest way to get one is a temp directory with a random name like /tmp/eval-7f3a2c. The agent sees that path on every turn, in the system prompt […]The post Does ‘eval’ in the workspace path change what your agent does? appeared first on Microsoft for Developers.
